title: .38 Special vs Prince Ruperts Drop at 170,000 FPS - Smarter Every Day 169
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day fires .22 Magnum and .38 Special bullets at Prince Rupert's drops, filmed at 170,000 frames per second. The slow-motion footage shows the bullet shattering against the glass tadpole while the drop initially survives.
why: Cited in Prince Rupert's drop threads as the best high-speed footage of a bullet hitting one.

quote.text: In high speed, you can see the bullet splat against the glass and break into shards, long before the glass breaks. Really neat.
